Title: Unleashing insights from data in Azure Cosmos DB with Power BI

Body.Content: We are pleased to announce the beta release of the Azure Cosmos DB connector for Power BI. The connector is preinstalled in latest version of Power BI Desktop, and it is available in PowerBI.com. Business analysts and information workers can now leverage Power BI to slice and dice data from Azure Cosmos DB and create insightful visualizations for their JSON data. For more information, please see Visualizing Azure Cosmos DB data with Power BI.
